meta.title: About Thiên Canh — Silk cut true beneath the clouds, hand-sewn inch by inch
meta.description: The story of Thiên Canh: an áo dài atelier born in the highlands of northwest Vietnam, cutting true to the grain and hand-sewing to your measurements, shoulders and the way you move.

pain.title: Why Off-the-Shelf Ao Dai Can Be Uncomfortable
pain.description: Many women hesitate to wear Ao Dai due to tight armholes, restricted breathing while sitting, or awkward fit. Thiên Canh resolves these pain points with advanced tailoring techniques.

armhole.title: Tight Armholes
armhole.text: Narrow cuts or rigid lines prevent you from lifting your arms comfortably or moving naturally.
armhole.fix: We lower and widen the armhole by 1.5–2cm while keeping a clean shoulder line, so you can raise your arms freely.

belly.title: Exposed Waistline
belly.text: Fitted fabrics without flexible ease can make you feel self-conscious and restricted when sitting down.
belly.fix: We refine the front drape and set the side slit at just the right height to flatter the waist when sitting or bending.

fit.title: Generic Size Charts
fit.text: Mass-produced sizing templates fail to accommodate the beautiful diversity of real body shapes.
fit.fix: Every pattern is cut to your own 12 measurements, then fitted and adjusted before finishing.

pain.solutionText: We re-engineered the armholes, waist ease, and slit points to ensure your Ao Dai is both stunning and comfortably wearable all day.

fit.title: Designed for Diverse Silhouette Profiles
fit.description: We analyze and design patterns around distinct body profiles to ensure personalized, optimal fit.

slender.label: Slender Profile
slender.note: Optimizing natural body curves and the elegant drape of silk panels.
slender.before: Flat front panel, vertical folding around shoulder lines, and loose waist definition.
slender.after: Enhanced bust silhouette, seamless shoulder drape, and refined, clean waist definition.
slender.imageAlt: Ao Dai on a slender figure

curvy.label: Curvy Profile
curvy.note: Smart ease added at armholes and smooth, flexible transitions around hips.
curvy.before: Restricted armhole movement, horizontal tension lines across hips, and tight waist pressure.
curvy.after: Comfortable armhole with +2cm ease, hidden waist pressure, and flexible hip ease.
curvy.imageAlt: Ao Dai on a curvy figure

atelier.title: The Care and Craft in Every Single Seam
atelier.description: Every single Thiên Canh gown passes through the skilled hands of our most experienced artisans.

founder.title: Linh An
founder.story: My aim is to keep the slow rhythm of the craft: true to the grain, cut for the person who will wear it, and hand-sewn to the very last stitch.

tailor.title: Ms. Mai Hanh
tailor.story: The beauty of Ao Dai lies in perfectly aligned seams and understanding how to guide the grain of silk along curves.

cutting.title: Mr. Hoàng Nam
cutting.story: Aligning the grain is what gives the dress its soul. A cut a few millimetres off can cost the panels their natural fall.

manifesto.text: A beautiful Ao Dai is one the wearer forgets she is wearing — leaving only confidence, comfort and a grace that is entirely her own.
manifesto.author: Linh An — Founder of Thiên Canh

cta.title: Your own Ao Dai starts with a conversation
cta.description: Book a free consultation in our atelier or online — we listen, measure and sketch together with you.

story.title: Why we are called Thiên Canh

paragraphs.origin: Unlike the busy garment factories of the city, every Thiên Canh áo dài begins in the stillness of the northwest Vietnamese highlands.
paragraphs.name: We named our atelier Thiên Canh for three things at once: the white clouds over the high country, the craft of aligning the fabric grain to the millimetre, and the long watches of the night an artisan keeps at the cutting table.
paragraphs.craft: At Thiên Canh, nothing is stamped out by the hundred. Each length of silk is cut to your own measurements, the set of your shoulders and the way you move. Slowly, patiently, with care in every hand stitch.

sky.title: The northwest sky
sky.text: Where the atelier began: high country wrapped in cloud all year, the air still and clear.

grain.title: Canh vải thiên — the bias cut
grain.text: The finest technique in áo dài making: cutting the cloth at 45 degrees, so the panels fall naturally and follow the body's curves without constraint.

watch.title: Canh khuya, canh cửi — the night watch
watch.text: The highland artisan at work late and early by lamp and sewing table, tending every stitch so the dress is ready for your happy day.
